mentions.name: Elixir agent framework
mentions.description: This Elixir-based agent framework pairs an append-only log with a content hypergraph, along with tools that regularly pull data from other services into Postgres. It is built as a kind of 'exoskeleton' around Claude/Codex so it does not compete with fast-moving agent tools.
mentions.source_excerpt: My take on an agent framework ... append only log + content hypergraph in Elixir, tools that regularly pull data from other services into Postgres—built as a kind of 'exoskeleton' around claude/codex so it's not competing with fast-moving tools.
mentions.author: tern
